**Table 4.** Summary of findings and certainty of evidence (GRADE for event rates; thresholds in Supplementary File S3, clarification C2)

| | Problem gambling (L3/L4) | Problem gambling, representative surveys | Moderate risk or higher (L2) | Any risk (L1) | Male-to-female odds ratio |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Samples (bettors) | 42 (27,394) | 5 (6,534) | 34 (26,189) | 31 (23,622) | 4 (6,117) |
| Estimate (95% CI) | 23.6% (18.7–29.4) | 15.8% (5.5–37.4) | 46.7% (38.5–55.0) | 74.2% (64.8–81.7) | OR 2.53 (0.97–6.57) |
| Risk of bias^a^ | Serious (86%) | Serious (59%) | Serious (97%) | Serious (91%) | Serious (75%) |
| Inconsistency^b^ | Serious (PI 4–68%) | Serious (PI 1–75%) | Serious (PI 11–86%) | Serious (PI 20–97%) | Serious (PI 0.43–14.80) |
| Imprecision^c^ | Serious (±5.3 points) | Serious (±15.9 points) | Serious (±8.3 points) | Serious (±8.5 points) | Serious (CI includes 1) |
| Indirectness^d^ | Not serious (16 countries, 4 regions) | Serious (5 countries, 2 regions) | Not serious (11 countries, 4 regions) | Not serious (12 countries, 4 regions) | Serious (3 countries, 3 regions) |
| Publication bias^e^ | Not detected (p = 0.16) | Not assessed (k < 10) | Not detected (p = 0.10) | Not detected (p = 0.43) | Not assessed (k < 10) |
| Certainty | **Very low** | **Very low** | **Very low** | **Very low** | **Very low** |

^a^ Share of the inverse-variance weight from samples rated no on JBI items 2, 6 or 9 (serious above 50%). ^b^ 95% prediction interval (prevalence: serious if wider than 30 percentage points; odds ratio: if it includes 1). ^c^ Half-width of the 95% CI in percentage points (serious above 5) or, for the odds ratio, a CI including 1. ^d^ Serious with fewer than five countries or three regions. ^e^ Regression of logit prevalence on 1/√n, assessed with at least 10 samples. Certainty starts high for event rates (Iorio et al., 2015) and is rated down one level per serious domain.
